notes: Linden, the Steadfast Queen. Printed: 'Vigilance. Whenever a white creature you control attacks, you gain 1 life.' Seat 0 attacks with Linden (white), White Knight (white) and Red Bear (red): two white attackers, so two triggers (one for each attacking creature, CR 508.3a) and 2 life (22); the red attacker gives none. Vigilance: Linden stays untapped, the two others tap. Unblocked, 3+2+2 = 7 damage: seat 1 at 13.
